about_the_game:
Gunfight Arena is a fast-paced top-down PvP shooter set in a futuristic sci-fi battlefield where every shot counts.

Compete against other players in intense online matches where powerful weapons spawn randomly across the map. Everyone starts with a basic pistol, but by taking out opponents and grabbing better gear—like shotguns, pulse rifles, or ricocheting projectiles—you can gain the upper hand. Die, and you return to your default weapon.

⚔️ Key Features:

  • Online multiplayer for 2–6 players in high-speed PvP matches.

  • One-hit kills – every bullet is deadly, and precision is everything.

  • A variety of powerful sci-fi weapons that spawn dynamically on the map.

  • Strategic sci-fi arena design with different obstacle types: shoot-through walls, full cover, fogged areas, and more.

  • Skill-based, no pay-to-win mechanics – just pure competitive gameplay.

Gunfight Arena is built for short, intense play sessions with tight controls and clean visuals. Whether you're in it for quick matches with your friends, Arena is waiting for you!!!

JOIN OUR DISCORD

Want to learn more about the game, get early insights into upcoming features and mechanics, or even support the development as a future playtester?

Join our community on Discord to stay up to date with behind-the-scenes updates and development progress.
Information about future playtesting opportunities will be shared there.

Be part of the journey from day one!

name: Gunfight Arena

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 3 3300X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570 (4GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-9700K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (8GB VRAM)
  • Storage: 3 GB available space

short_description: Fast-paced top-down PvP shooter where powerful weapons spawn across the map. Grab them fast, outgun your enemies—and beware: death or the ticking clock will send you back to your default gun. Outplay, survive, and claim your spot at the top. Don’t waste a second.
